name: recent-strip
title: Recent Strip
description: One row of the records a person opened last — compact cards in a sideways strip with edge fades and roving arrow keys, a single line of chips on a phone, collapsible, with a same-shape skeleton.

meta.whenToUse: A Recent row above a list (the Library home) or Home's Jump back in: up to six records to return to, one tap away, without pushing the main list down.
meta.whenNotToUse: The main list of records (DataList), a grid of every item (DataList view="grid"), or a record's own links (RecordChip).
